svg.title: Detailed low poly jetski icon, N64 era style
svg.desc: A faceted low-polygon personal watercraft seen from a three-quarter isometric angle. Pink hull with a cream waterline stripe, dark grey footwell, yellow saddle seat, teal engine cowling with vents, a steering column with handlebars and grips, and a small windscreen. It sits in a flat-shaded plate of blue water with white foam along the waterline and a splash at the bow.
